summary: Promote a complete, content-hashed and independently reconstructed proof that every adjacent gap with n>=2 attains both extrema over the full measurable density box and that every global extremizer is bang-bang with at most 2n effective switches.

row.title: All-n finite-block reduction for adjacent weighted Dirichlet gaps
row.headline_value: For every n>=2 and R>1, both gap extrema exist and every extremizer is bang-bang with at most 2n switches
row.scope: All measurable densities 1<=rho<=R a.e. on (0,1), every finite R>1, every integer n>=2, both global maxima and minima
row.main_limitation: No symmetry, uniqueness, exact-switch, optimizer-pattern, optimal-value, or novelty claim; not formal-proof-assistant verified

rationale.quantifier_alignment: The proof fixes arbitrary finite R>1 and integer n>=2 and then treats every member of both global extremizer sets; no uniform-in-R margin or selected-extremizer weakening is used.
rationale.proof_mechanism: Weak-star spectral continuity gives attainment; strict consecutive-eigenfunction Wronskian sign gives at most 2n switching-function zeros; an ambient Feynman-Hellmann derivative plus localized one-sided box directions forces endpoint saturation; the finite zero set yields the effective switch bound.
rationale.independence: The Wronskian and variational routes were frozen before reading each other or the synthesis. A separate synthesis auditor reconstructed all four inferences and returned PASS with no findings.
rationale.computation_policy: The 385 finite spectral-pair checks are bounded adversarial evidence only and are not used to propagate the universal theorem.
rationale.novelty_policy: No novelty or priority claim is made. The literature audit found broad older extremal-characterization precedent whose exact overlap could not be resolved from accessible full text.
rationale.scope_boundary: Symmetry, uniqueness, exact 2n switches, optimizer topology, optimal values, and parameter-transition laws remain open.

math_premise_contracts.scope: Every finite real R>1 and every integer n>=2.
math_premise_contracts.contract_explanation: This is the user-frozen quantifier domain, not a research conclusion.

math_premise_contracts.scope: Measurable positive density box, regular weighted Dirichlet spectrum, and every adjacent gap.
math_premise_contracts.contract_explanation: The proof remains inside the exact L-infinity a.e. category and uses the canonical eigenvalue ordering and gap definition.

math_premise_contracts.scope: A.e. endpoint-valued finite-step representatives after inactive adjacent cells are merged.
math_premise_contracts.contract_explanation: The synthesis counts effective interior switches and excludes fixed Dirichlet endpoints and isolated representative choices.

ordered_steps: Construct the positive compact operator T_rho on H_0^1 and derive its spectral basis and generalized min-max formula.
Prove sequential weak-star compactness of K_R by a countable-dense-test diagonal argument and preserve the box inequalities.
Prove the limsup inequality on a fixed spectral k-plane using uniform convergence of denominators.
Pass a moving weighted-orthonormal k-frame through weak H_0^1 and strong L2 convergence to prove the liminf inequality without loss of dimension.
Apply eigenvalue continuity to maximizing and minimizing sequences to attain both extrema.
boundary_cases: Rapidly oscillating measurable weights and weak-star limits remain in K_R.
Every fixed finite R>1 and n>=2 is covered; no estimate divides by R-1.
The moving weighted Gram matrix and all k limiting directions are retained.
external_results: No specialized theorem is imported as an unexpanded premise; the compact positive spectral construction is included in the proof package, and the cited Teschl theorem is corroborative only.

ordered_steps: Derive exact nodal counts at L-infinity regularity from a lifted Prüfer angle strictly increasing in x and lambda.
Use an integrated strict comparison identity plus the nodal counts to prove exactly one u_{n+1} zero inside every u_n nodal cell.
Orient both modes at the left endpoint and use W'=-(lambda_{n+1}-lambda_n)rho u_nu_{n+1} together with nodal endpoint signs to prove W<0 throughout (0,1).
Conclude that u_{n+1}/u_n is strictly decreasing on each of the n nodal intervals.
Identify F_n=0 with two quotient levels and obtain at most two simple zeros per nodal interval, hence at most 2n and no positive-measure zero set.
boundary_cases: The first and last nodal intervals use the common zero Wronskian values at 0 and 1 explicitly.
Strict interlacing excludes common interior zeros and shows F_n is negative at every quotient pole.
The proof covers n=2 and in fact the stronger consistency range n>=1.
external_results: No smooth-coefficient Sturm theorem is imported; ODE uniqueness, Prüfer identities, nodal count, comparison, and interlacing are all derived in the proof package.

ordered_steps: Represent weight perturbations by the affine compact-operator identity T_{rho+epsilon h}=T_rho+epsilon T_h for arbitrary h in L-infinity.
Use compactness and simple spectral isolation to prove eigenvector convergence rather than assume differentiability.
Take an exact perturbed eigen-equation inner product to obtain lambda_k'[h]=-lambda_k int h u_k^2 and D_n'[h]=int hF_n.
Localize feasible positive and negative directions on uniformly inactive level sets of the upper and lower box constraints.
Derive the correct maximum/minimum endpoint assignments and use the finite F_n zero set to eliminate singular arcs and prove bang-bang saturation for every global extremizer.
boundary_cases: The ambient derivative is two-sided in the positive cone while optimality is used only on the feasible side.
The exhaustion by rho<=R-1/m and rho>=1+1/m handles the absence of a uniform step on the full nonsaturated set.
Maximum and minimum signs are separately derived, and all conclusions are a.e. representative invariant.

ordered_steps: Use CLM-NGE2-EXISTENCE to ensure both extremizer sets are nonempty.
For an arbitrary maximizer or minimizer, use CLM-NGE2-BANGBANG to fix one endpoint density value a.e. on each strict-sign component of F_n.
Use CLM-NGE2-ZERO-BOUND and continuity to obtain at most 2n+1 complementary sign intervals.
Assign arbitrary endpoint values at the finite zero points and merge adjacent equal cells.
Conclude at most 2n effective switches for every global extremizer, exactly CLM-NGE2-FINITE-REDUCTION.
boundary_cases: Dirichlet endpoints are partition endpoints and not interior switches.
Tangential or inactive zero points cannot inflate the count because adjacent equal cells are merged.
The implication treats every extremizer and does not assert symmetry, uniqueness, or exact switch activity.

math_research_state_records.status_justification: Both weak-star spectral-convergence directions and attainment are proved in the exact measurable box.
Strict interlacing, endpoint-cell signs, global Wronskian negativity, and quotient monotonicity are proved for measurable positive bounded weights.
The arbitrary-L-infinity Feynman-Hellmann derivative and exact one-sided pointwise saturation implications are proved.
The isolated route produced a complete proof of the strict Wronskian and 2n zero bound.
The isolated route produced complete existence and first-variation proofs and the exact conditional saturation implication.
The finite route found no target counterexample in 385 spectral-pair checks but has no universal completeness certificate; it did expose failures of a stronger exact-zero assertion.
The route mapped close primary precedents but could not determine exact prior overlap or novelty from inaccessible older full texts.
The given domain propagates through the four proved inferences to CLM-NGE2-FINITE-REDUCTION with no unresolved obligation in the candidate trusted closure.
